message: So, we had a little blackout the other night, and let me tell you, the family group chat was buzzing! Between sharing flashlight tips and debating what snacks to raid from the pantry, it was a reminder that being prepared makes all the difference. I've found this handy resource that covers what to do during power outages—it’s like having a little guidebook for those unexpected moments. Next time the lights go out, let’s keep the chat lively and our minds calm!
